episodes.title: The Big City
episodes.summary: Longing to become a samurai, Usagi heads to the city of Neo Edo — where he accidentally frees a villain who was imprisoned for a thousand years.

episodes.title: Yokai
episodes.summary: Usagi and his friends battle Kagehito — a spider-like Yokai with multiple arms, legs and eyeballs — then must save Lord Kogane from an attack.

episodes.title: Possessions
episodes.summary: Usagi, Kitsune, Chizu and Gen head to the cultural center, where they encounter a Yokai that lives inside neglected things and one that can change shape.

episodes.title: Run Rabbit Run
episodes.summary: Gen receives treatment at the hospital as Usagi and Kitsune wind up in the middle of a disagreement between the Mogura and Bat Squadron.

episodes.title: Common Sensei
episodes.summary: Karasu-Tengu agrees to be Usagi's sensei if he captures the three Urban Yokai. Lady Fuwa launches her plan to rule Neo Edo by stealing the Ki-Stone.

episodes.title: Nobody Likes A Ninja
episodes.summary: The Neko Ninja Crew attacks the temple, forcing Chizu to choose a side. Gen heads over to his side job while Usagi searches for the second Yokai.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.summary: After Usagi and Chizu search for the last Urban Yokai in the Hidden Dojo, Usagi has a change of heart. Kagehito gets closer to finding his missing item.

episodes.title: Go
episodes.summary: Chikabuma sneaks away to warn Gen, Toshiko, Chizu and Kitsune about Kagehito's plan. After Usagi proves himself worthy, Karasu-Tengu agrees to train him.

episodes.title: Kagehito Unleashed
episodes.summary: Usagi reunites with the team as they battle Lady Fuwa and her ninjas. Kagehito launches a savage attack to attach the Clavis to the Ki-Stone.

episodes.title: Soul Oath
episodes.summary: The Ki-Stone fights to close the portal to would-be alien invaders but is missing an important piece. Can Usagi and the team find it in time?

episodes.title: Runaway Training
episodes.summary: The Ki-Stone gifts Chizu, Kitsune and Gen with weapons, but they don`t know why. Usagi makes himself their sensei and trains them to use their new hear.

episodes.title: Game Dogs
episodes.summary: The gang tries out a new fighting game at the arcade. Usagi vows to stop battling Yokai but later gets attacked by O-Dokuro, a Yoaki-possessed skleleton.

episodes.title: The Fuzzy Pony
episodes.summary: Chizu challenges Lady Fuwa for control of the Neko Ninja Crew. Usagi and Gen plan a party for Kitsune when they learn she`s never celebrated a birthday.

episodes.title: Adventures in Ninjasitting
episodes.summary: Usagi and Gen volunteer to show the ninja kids that there`s a lot more to life outside the dojo. The Bat Squadron attacks the temple.

episodes.title: Interdimensionals
episodes.summary: After Kagehito warns of the coming Makkine invasion, the gang sets out to recruit the ninja and Mogura as allies. Lady Fuwa plots revenge against Chizu.

episodes.title: Warbotto
episodes.summary: Kagehito needs the team`s help to retrieve a precious item. Makkine warbottos are appearing all over town... but where are they coming from?

episodes.title: Willow Branch
episodes.summary: O-Dokuro leads the team to an ancient battlefield, where Usagi hopes to retrieve his ancestor`s sword to cut off the approaching invasion.

episodes.title: The Chizu Stands Alone
episodes.summary: Tetsujin debuts his defensebotto but needs someone to drive it. Chizu confronts Lady Fuwa in a final fight to lead the Neko Ninja Crew.

episodes.title: Eggs!
episodes.summary: Kagehito realizes what Kitsune`s pet egg really is. An ill-timed attack by the Bat Squadron leads to disaster, allowing the Makkine to invade.

episodes.title: Invasion!
episodes.summary: All of Neo Edo must come together to fight as the Makkine send a giant monster and an army of warbottos through the gateway. Can the city be saved?
